jobs.description: You're the brains behind our work. You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility-career growth is not a question of if, but when. What is Services? Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world. In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio. We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed. The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research. Your time here will look something like this: Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors. Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth. Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk. Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings. Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership. Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development. We want to hear from you if... You are a junior in college, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook. You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn. Who we think will be a great fit... We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone-not just those with business degrees-can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for: Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Excellent communication skills. A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail. Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously - self-starter. A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn. Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently. Your future at Citi Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full-time Analysts upon graduation. During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services. Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi! We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. jobs.description: About Vantage Data Centers Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Position Overview Vantage is looking for a driven Senior Project Manager to play a key leadership role within the Construction team, leading the delivery of large-scale data center construction projects from conception through commissioning. This role will be based in Hong Kong and will primarily support the successful close-out and delivery of the TPE11 project, alongside broader APAC regional initiatives as required. This position is responsible for managing complex and highly technical construction projects, overseeing both internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment across Sales, Operations, Development, Engineering, Procurement, Commercial, and Critical Operations teams. The role will be responsible for construction projects that involve customer integration and requires excellent communication , stakeholder management, and organizational skills to navigate changing requirements while balancing commercial , operational, and schedule impacts. Collaboration and integration across the construction lifecycle are integral to the role. Coordination and translation of requirements from Vantage’s internal subject matter experts, external consultants, contractors, suppliers, and global customers ensures long-term operational sustainability is preserved while driving optimized construction delivery. The Senior Project Manager will oversee end-to-end delivery of construction and capital expenditure works, including project planning, contractor management, procurement coordination, commercial oversight, project controls, customer-facing communication, issue resolution, and executive reporting. This is a high-visibility role that provides the opportunity to shape Vantage’s project delivery standards and operational excellence across the APAC region. Essential Job Functions Project Delivery: Lead the successful delivery and close-out of the TPE11 data center project, ensuring all construction, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness milestones are achieved. Oversee large-scale, complex data center construction projects from conception through commissioning, including utility interfacing, budgets, schedules, procurement strategies, ECI coordination, and construction execution. Stakeholder Management and Customer Integration: Manage stakeholder expectations and customer integration requirements across internal leadership teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers, and global customers. Support customer-facing activities, including project updates, stakeholder engagement, issue resolution, change control communication, and executive reporting to ensure end-user satisfaction. Project Controls and Administration: Manage consulting deliverables and ensure alignment with project objectives, milestones, and governance requirements. Supervise in-house Quantity Surveyors (QS) and oversee commercial administration activities including contracts, progress claims, variation management, certificates, and related documentation. Monitor and report on project budgets, timelines, risks, forecasting, and critical milestones to ensure successful delivery outcomes. Contractor and Vendor Management: Manage contractors, consultants, suppliers, and vendors to ensure performance, compliance, and alignment with project objectives. Oversee logistics, procurement coordination, and site delivery activities to support project schedules and operational readiness, while driving accountability across external delivery partners. Safety and Compliance: Act as a visible safety leader, fostering a culture of safety, security, and environmental responsibility across in-house teams, contractors, and delivery partners. Ensure compliance with all local authority requirements, health and safety regulations, environmental standards, and Vantage policies throughout project execution. Cross-Functional Coordination: Lead coordination and integration across internal teams including New Site Development (NSD), Design & Engineering (D&E), Construction, Procurement, Commercial, and Critical Operations. Collaborate closely with regional and global stakeholders to ensure consistent delivery standards, operational readiness, and delivery excellence in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with exposure to global customers and technically complex infrastructure challenges. Duties Implement and standardize, as far as practically possible, Vantage’s highest standards of cost, quality, safety, and programme control throughout design, build, commissioning, handover, and transition phases. Lead onsite safety management procedures and ensure compliance with mandatory, industry, local authority, environmental, and Vantage standards. Support contract negotiations, procurement strategies, and commercial reviews to ensure quality, cost, schedule, and delivery objectives are achieved. Identify, track, and pursue opportunities to innovate design, de-risk programme delivery, manage budget exposure, improve project quality, and maintain operational sustainability. Lead and coordinate internal teams, external consultants, contractors, vendors, and delivery partners through the design, construction, commissioning, and handover of data centers. Work with internal legal counsel and procurement to prepare, review, and support revisions, changes, and additions to contractual agreements with architects, consultants, clients, suppliers, and subcontractors. Conduct regular project review meetings with consultants, contractors, customers, and internal stakeholders, both on and off site, and communicate project status, risks, issues, cost, and schedule impacts clearly. Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive-level reports that provide accurate information on project progress, risk, cost, schedule, cash flow, change control, and delivery outcomes. Ensure all project plans and information are properly communicated and understood by relevant Vantage teams, including costs, design schedules, procurement status, construction issues, technical data, contractor invoices and payments, funding requirements, and change order notifications. Manage stakeholder expectations and customer integration requirements, ensuring effective change control, timely issue resolution, and clear alignment between customer needs, project delivery constraints, and operational readiness. Ensure timely resolution of issues and deficiencies and develop contingency plans to recover project cost and schedule slippage when appropriate. Ensure proper and complete handover of completed works to Vantage operations teams and relevant customer stakeholders. Maintain regular liaison with MEP consultants, Engineering teams, power authorities, and relevant technical stakeholders to support correct design and implementation of utility and power requirements. Participate in a culture of teamwork, continuous improvement, accountability, and delivery excellence. Job Requirements Bachelor of Science degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 to 10 years of experience in a senior project management or construction management role, with substantial experience delivering large-scale and technically complex projects. Data center industry experience is preferred. Candidates from Tier 1 or Tier 2 general contractors with proven experience managing projects valued at USD $500M+ are highly regarded. Candidates with large-scale consultancy experience, including mechanical, electrical, civil, or structural disciplines, and experience across complex infrastructure sectors such as hospitals, government, industrial, or mission-critical facilities are encouraged to apply. Strong experience in CSA (Civil, Structural, Architectural) and/or MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) construction management. Proven experience managing stakeholders, contractors, consultants, vendors, and customer relationships in high-pressure delivery environments. Excellent communication skills are essential, with the ability to clearly manage expectations, translate technical and commercial requirements, and engage confidently with internal stakeholders and hyperscaler customers. Experience in a customer-facing project delivery role is highly preferred, particularly where the role has required direct engagement with hyperscaler customers, end users, or other external client stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, contracts, procurement, change control, and project risk. Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment with regional and global stakeholder exposure. Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools such as MS Project and Primavera P6. Experience preparing and delivering executive-level presentations and reporting. PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is preferred. We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage Data Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer Vantage Data Centers does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage Data Centers.

We are headquartered in Singapore, with our main engineering hub in Vietnam and operating banks in South Africa and the Philippines. About GoTymeX GoTymeX is the engineering, product, and design organisation that builds the digital products powering the GoTyme Group. Our product culture is customer-first, data-driven with an emphasis on end-to-end ownership of the customer experience and its success. About the product The Investments and Digital Assets Portfolio is where GoTyme brings wealth-building to customers who have historically been locked out of it. Within it, the Investments pod owns the Group's Digital Assets, and Equities products today, with additional asset classes on the horizon. This team owns the experience that let's a first-time investor buy their first share or their first coin in a few taps, with the safety, transparency and regulatory substance they expect from their bank. The pod operates with the speed of a startup, backed by the resources of a multi-country group. It shares infrastructure with our wider digital-asset portfolio (custody, wallets, ledgering, screening and on-chain settlement), so there is real scope to build once and scale across products and markets. The Role We are looking for a Product Owner to join the Investments pod and own the roadmap and delivery of our trading products. You will sit at the intersection of retail banking, capital markets and crypto, turning complex market and digital-asset mechanics into experiences that feel as simple as the rest of a banking app for a mass-market customer. The role is hands-on. You will own the backlog, write the user stories, run the sprint cadence, drive partner and vendor integrations, and be accountable for what ships and for how it performs after launch. The successful candidate has shipped regulated consumer financial products at the quality bar regulators demand, and is comfortable working across both traditional securities and crypto. What you will do Own the product backlog end-to-end: translate the proposition into epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritise against time-to-market, regulatory constraint and customer value. Own the customer experience across the trading lifecycle for stocks, crypto, and future asset classes: onboarding and suitability, funding, order placement and execution, portfolio and holdings, statements, tax and regulatory reporting, and servicing. Translate between capital markets, crypto and retail banking. Convert market mechanics (order types, market hours, settlement cycles, corporate actions, fractional ownership) and digital-asset mechanics (custody, multi-chain support, screening and Travel Rule, on-chain settlement) into product experiences a first-time investor can use. Equally, translate retail banking expectations (KYC step-up, dispute handling, regulatory reporting, AML monitoring, ledgering) into requirements our brokerage, exchange and infrastructure partners can build against. Drive partner and vendor integration. You will own the product-side relationship with brokers, liquidity providers, custodians and market data providers, treating each partner as part of the user experience rather than a black box behind it. Define and track success: set product KPIs (activation, funded accounts, trading volumes, retention, revenue per user), run experiments and use data to decide what to build next. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. We will value your care, judgement and willingness to learn more than years of experience. **Key responsibilities** **Order fulfilment and eCommerce operations** • Oversee the daily flow of online orders, including order checks, processing, fulfilment coordination and delivery follow\-up. • Track orders through to completion; spot payment, stock, packing, dispatch or delivery exceptions and coordinate a resolution before they become customer problems. • Keep order information and operational records accurate, and communicate changes or delays clearly to the relevant teams and customers. • Coordinate with internal colleagues and external warehouse, fulfilment and logistics partners to keep orders moving smoothly, including recurring subscription orders. **Inventory planning and accuracy** • Monitor stock levels and maintain accurate inventory records across products and operational partners. • Estimate upcoming stock needs using recent sales, subscription demand, promotions, product launches and supplier lead times; flag potential shortages or excess stock early. • Reconcile inventory and investigate discrepancies, working with the relevant teams on replenishment and corrective actions. **Partner service performance** • Monitor fulfilment and delivery partners against Mylo's agreed service commitments, including order accuracy, dispatch and delivery timeliness, and issue resolution. • Maintain simple performance reports, identify recurring issues, follow up with partners, and help improve processes where service falls short. **Customer care and continuous improvement** • Respond to customer enquiries through Mylo's service channels promptly, accurately, patiently and with empathy. • Take ownership of order, delivery and after\-sales issues: keep customers updated, coordinate solutions, and close the loop rather than simply passing cases on. • Provide product information using approved guidance; refer nutrition or health\-related questions to the appropriate qualified team member rather than offering unsupported advice. • Identify patterns in enquiries, fulfilment errors and partner issues, and suggest practical changes to improve the customer experience. **About you** • **Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.** Experience in eCommerce, customer service, order fulfilment, inventory or logistics is helpful but not required. • You are exceptionally **detail\-minded and organised** : you check your work, keep good records, and follow through until a task is complete. • You **love pets and care about their wellbeing** , and you understand that every order matters to a pet parent. • You are **patient and empathetic** , especially when a customer is worried or something has gone wrong. • You communicate clearly and professionally with customers, teammates and external partners. • You are comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets, and willing to learn eCommerce, inventory and customer service tools. Our range includes **MyloMeals** , gently cooked functional fresh meals; **MyloMix** , a precision nutrient mix for guided home cooking with the free Mylo Cookbook developed by Dr. Moran; and **MyloBiome** , 2\-in\-1 functional biotic and supplement formulas. We are a fast\-moving team working to make trustworthy pet nutrition more accessible in Hong Kong and beyond.

We're building the AI CFO - an intelligent, proactive agent that helps businesses manage their money before problems arise, not after. We sit on rich financial data and real operational workflows. Now we're putting AI at the centre of that. This isn't starting from zero. Our card operations agent is about to go live internally - we dogfood our own product, so you'll see the impact of what you build firsthand before it reaches external clients. Your job is to take it from 0.1 to 1 - refining reliability, building observability into every layer, and making the decisions that turn a working prototype into a production-grade system businesses trust with their financial operations. You'll work alongside our AI Product Manager to expand from card operations into accounting automation, policy enablement, and beyond - tackling the workflows that drain finance and finops teams of time and energy. Every agent you build needs to be compliant, reliable, and handle PII with the seriousness that fintech demands. You'll also need to think critically about unit economics and adoption - an agent nobody uses or that costs more than it saves isn't worth shipping. If you come from a fintech background and understand why PII handling isn't optional, that's ideal. If you don't but you have the chutzpah to figure it out and get genuinely excited every time a new model drops, we want to talk to you too. Your Mission Awaits Take our card operations agent from internal pilot to production - building the reliability, observability, and guardrails needed for a system handling real financial data and PII. Own the tradeoffs between latency, model selection, cost, and safety - making pragmatic architectural decisions that keep our unit economics viable as we scale. Build agent systems that are proactive, not reactive - designing solutions that anticipate what finance teams need rather than waiting to be asked. Expand agent capabilities across accounting automation, policy enablement, and card operations - working with the AI Product Lead to prioritise what moves the needle for adoption. Stay sharp on the frontier of LLM research and tooling - evaluate new models, methods, and architectures and bring what works into our stack. Think like a product engineer, not just an AI engineer - every system you build should drive platform adoption and make clients' lives measurably easier. Your Superpowers 8+ years of experience in full-stack or backend development - with strong proficiency in Python as your primary stack. Experience with Java, Golang, or Rust is equally welcome. Strong software engineering foundation - experience designing distributed systems, APIs, and scalable backend architectures. 1-2+ years of hands-on experience building AI agents in production - you've gone beyond prompting LLMs and have shipped systems that reason, plan, and act. Deep understanding of LLM internals - you know how models work under the hood, not just how to call an API. Architectural thinking beyond frameworks - you can evaluate when LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or other agent frameworks are the right tool, and when to build from first principles. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) - you understand what MCPs are and how they enable agent-tool interoperability. Leadership and delegation instincts - you're comfortable guiding and reviewing the work of others, and you operate with ownership over outcomes, not just tasks. Excellent communication skills - you can translate complex technical decisions into clear reasoning for engineering and product stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services (though strong engineers adapt - domain knowledge can be learned). Proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript. jobs.description: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes-from emerging brands to Fortune 500s-use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own strategy across Ops Tech-the operational backbone of Flexport's freight forwarding business-and lead the build of an AI-powered freight operating system that automates the majority of work our operators do today. This is not a single-feature role, and it's not incremental tooling. You will define the vision for how multiple operational product surfaces work together across the shipment lifecycle-from exception handling to end-to-end task automation-then execute against that vision with a high degree of autonomy. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and business outcomes. The systems you build will directly move Flexport's cost structure, throughput, and service quality, so you'll be measured not by features shipped but by the operational and financial impact you realize. You'll also be reengineering how the business runs: designing the product often means redesigning the operating process itself, and persuading operations and commercial leaders to adopt a new operating model. Think of it as equal parts product management, process engineering, and internal consulting-at a scope that spans multiple engineering teams and other PMs. You will raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face. This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment. What You'll Do Own the vision and strategy for the AI-powered freight operating system. Define how multiple operational surfaces work together to automate work end-to-end-identifying the highest-leverage workflows, sequencing investment, designing AI/automation solutions that handle them, and progressively removing humans from the loop while improving accuracy and speed. Drive business impact, not just product output. Tie every initiative to a measurable business result-cost savings, productivity per operator, cycle time, error reduction, margin. Define the metrics, instrument them, and own the P&L-level outcomes of what your domain ships. Reengineer operations, don't just digitize them. Map and redesign the underlying operational processes before automating them. Bring strong process-engineering and consulting skills to challenge how work is done today and influence operations and commercial stakeholders toward a new, leaner operating model. Own your domain end-to-end, from problem discovery and process diagnosis through launch, adoption, and iteration across the workflows and teams in your area. Partner deeply across functions-Engineering, Design, Operations, Commercial, and regional leaders-to align competing priorities and translate complex, multi-step logistics workflows into automated, intuitive systems delivered as cohesive experiences. Use data to set direction, not just measure results. Build metrics frameworks that connect automation rates, operator adoption, product health, and business outcomes, and use them to guide where to invest next across your domain. Represent your domain in leadership forums, influencing resource allocation and strategic direction for how Flexport's operations scale through software and AI. Mentor PMs on the team: raise the bar for how we write specs, prioritize, communicate trade-offs, and ship. What You Should Have 8+ years of product management experience. Demonstrated ability to own a product domain (not just a feature or single product area) and drive outcomes across multiple teams. A track record of building products that delivered quantifiable business impact (e.g., cost reduction, automation of manual work, throughput gains)-and a default of measuring success in business terms, not feature counts. Demonstrated operational process engineering and consulting ability: you can diagnose how a complex process works, redesign it, and influence stakeholders to adopt a new operating model. Experience building automation, workflow, or AI-powered products that replaced or significantly reduced manual human effort. Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You build metrics frameworks, write your own queries, and use data to settle debates. SQL proficiency required. A track record of shipping intuitive UX in data-dense, complex domains where the user workflow spans multiple steps or systems. Experience aligning cross-functional teams (engineering, design, operations, commercial) around a shared roadmap when priorities compete. Proven ability to operate at the strategy level (where should we invest, and why) and the execution level (what ships this quarter, and what does "done" look like) in the same week. Excellent written and verbal communication, especially the ability to frame trade-offs, present recommendations to senior leadership, and create clarity in ambiguous situations. Experience mentoring or leading other PMs, formally or informally. Experience with B2B workflow software, supply chain platforms, or logistics technology is a plus. Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain operations is highly desirable. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.description: Siemens Graduate Programs | Siemens Skip to main content Home Company Jobs & careers Growth & Careers Siemens Graduate Program Reach new heights with SGP Siemens Graduate Program Join the two-year entry-level program for master graduates. Embark on three challenging placements, including an international experience. Benefit from tailored training, a dynamic network, and dedicated mentorship, boosting your global career and fostering valuable intercultural skills. Apply now When it comes to getting ahead, leave nothing to chance As an ambitious graduate, you want to reach the top - that’s clear. But there are many challenges on the way. That’s why it’s incredibly important to identify your own strengths and weaknesses and know that you have the right partners at your side. That’s exactly what our Siemens Graduate Program is for. In two years and three different assignments, it offers everything you need to launch a successful career at Siemens. We’re looking for people who want to face the challenges of tomorrow. Do you think you have what it takes? Then we look forward to receiving your application. 24 months Program duration - two years that will change your life 3 assignments Each of 8 months - one of them abroad at one of our 190 locations globally 1 unique community Your career network - with 100 active participants of 20 nationalities The challenge: tough. The reward: huge. There are some things you have to experience yourself to understand. That’s why we asked people who have been through the Siemens Graduate Program (SGP) to tell us about their experience. Find out what our successful participants have to say. For me, the characteristics that are most prominent in successful SGP participants are ambition, drive, and ownership. Ambition pushes us to set high goals and fully leverage the learning opportunities provided by the program. Drive is the fuel that keeps participants actively engaged, persistent, and resilient in the face of challenges. The SGP is a self-driven program that requires participants to take ownership of their career development. Enzo, SGP Alum The SGP has been a tremendous accelerator for my professional development. I've had the opportunity to experience various positions, work with diverse teams and managers, and explore different locations. The extensive training program and community with other trainees served as the perfect counterpart, enabling me to reflect on my experiences and grow not only professionally but also on a personal level. Liam, SGP Alum The changing environment during the SGP makes me feel excited and invigorated. Each shift-whether it's a rotation to a new department, a novel project, or a change in team dynamics-presents fresh learning opportunities. These changes push me to adapt, develop new skills, and continually redefine my role as a professional. It's a process of ongoing discovery that keeps me engaged and motivated. Irene, SGP Participant The incredible support and mentorship within this network have enabled me to take on challenging projects with confidence and grow in my role. The continuous learning environment promotes the sharing of knowledge and expertise, enabling me to stay ahead of industry trends and developments. João, SGP Participant It is very humbling to see and meet people from so many different countries and cultures. I believe the exchange that happens when people come from diverse cultural backgrounds is enriching and enlightening. I met so many great people, experienced different work and leadership styles, and got to see many things from a new perspective. Shrija, SGP Alum Discover what to expect along your journey. Growth Our trainee program will equip you with all the fundamentals you need to succeed. In addition to developing your leadership skills, you’ll learn to communicate more effectively and perform with greater confidence. Teamwork You’ll be assigned a personal mentor from the start. You’ll also be involved in the day-to-day work of our project teams and assume responsibility for your tasks from then on. Ambition Together with your development manager, you design your individual program. Whatever your path looks like - you’ll build up deep knowledge, gain experience, and make contacts for the future. What would your assignment look like? See an example. Abiola was a SGP participant at Siemens Mobility from 2020 to 2022. I was born and raised in Nigeria. After my bachelor’s degree in Akure, Nigeria, I obtained a master’s degree at the prestigious Technical University of Munich, Germany. In my first assignment, my task was to create a Business Intelligence pipeline to understand the market and competition for a new Siemens business area. This required strategic thinking, strong communication skills, and the ability to create well-considered content. It was very exciting to know that I was part of a team working on future technology. Besides my assignment, I really enjoy participating in and organizing events for SGP participants. My light-bulb moment during the SGP? Realising that I can leverage on such a huge ecosystem to do what I love in my career. Abiola, SGP Participant, Siemens Mobility since November 2020 Ready to start? While talent and good starting conditions help, what really makes a difference is willpower and perseverance. The Siemens Graduate Program is no different. If you think you meet our requirements and want to accept the challenge, we’d be delighted to receive your application. Educational background You have completed or are about to complete your master’s studies (or equivalent) with above-average grades in engineering, business or other related disciplines. Work experience & ambition You have gained work experience during your studies or between your bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Also, you demonstrate willingness to take responsibility at early career stages. International mindset You have gained profound intercultural experience by working or studying in a foreign cultural area - our requirement is at least four months abroad. Generally, you have a global perspective and a desire to work abroad. Locations to start your journey What makes the Siemens Graduate Program truly unique is our international community and our global setup. Start your journey at one of our SGP locations - from Americas via Europe to Asia. See locations What to expect from our application process? At the SGP team, we believe in a thorough and holistic assessment - for us but also for you. This is an important step in your career and we want to give you ample opportunity to understand if the program is the right choice for you. We, on the other hand, want to get to know you, your personality, experience and capabilities. The process has three major steps, with slight country variations, but they all follow the same flow and logic. CV Screening A careful review of your resume and supporting documents based on the criteria detailed in the qualification section above. If you meet our basic requirements, you will be invited to the next step. Initial interview This initial interview will either take place in person, telephone or live meeting or as a video interview. In some countries we will also invite to an psychometric assessment. Assessment center In the last step - the assessment center (virtual or onsite) we can get to know each other. SGP decision-makers will be present, so this is the time for you to show us in various modules that you want to make a difference. Frequently asked questions When will the SGP start? When should I apply? The individual start depends on your availability as well as the demand in the respective country. We recommend that you check vacancies on a quarterly basis. These will be published as soon as they are available. In principle, applications and recruitments are possible during the whole year. What is the role of the mentor? The mentor plays an important role in making the program successful and a good and valuable experience for you. To support you personally and to develop your potential, the mentor offers regular touchpoints with the SGP Participant. Furthermore, the assignment planning is coordinated by the development manager taking into consideration the business demand and competencies that need to be established while the mentor shares personal expertise and experience by reflecting on opportunities and growth goals with you. Is the assignment abroad mandatory? In general, at least one assignment abroad is planned. Being a global company, the assignment abroad will prepare you for an important aspect of our culture. We will support you in selecting the best destination for your assignment abroad so you can get the most out of it. We try to ensure this also during the pandemic, but of course we need to adapt to the current requirements and the international travel restrictions. What should I do if my selected country does not offer a position for the SGP? If the SGP is not available in your selected country, or if there are no open positions, it is possible to apply in other countries. Please check the country requirements above and please note, you should only apply in a different country if this meets your career aspirations and you can get work authorization. You can also view your local careers page for other development programs or entry-level opportunities. What is my employment status as a member of the SGP Program? Being part of the Siemens Graduate Program means you’re a real Siemens employee with a regular permanent employment contract. The conditions of this contract depend on local requirements and regulations. It’s important to point out that the SGP is not an internship program. Which areas will I be working in? You’ll directly work within our divisions and experience different areas, such as product development and distribution, product management and marketing, manufacturing, project management or procurement and logistics. Ultimately these are decided by your interests and qualifications as well as our business requirements. What are the career prospects at Siemens after such a program? The Siemens Graduate Program gives you the chance to make an excellent start to your career with a wide range of prospects through various assignments in your home country and abroad, comprehensive trainings and mentoring. A key advantage of the program is that it is tailored to to your strengths and skills as well as to the needs of the respective company. Immediately after the SGP, you will take on your first challenging position. However, your individual career path always depends on your own initiative as well as your motivational strength. What type of position could I expect after the program? This greatly depends on your performance and interests during the program. You’ll discuss this with your development manager throughout and they will support you in your transition once the program comes to an end. You may be offered a position in your home country or abroad based on availability. We’ll support you in either an expert career, management career or project management career. Any more questions? If you can’t find what you’re looking for, just send us an email. Due to data protection and legal requirements, we are not allowed to accept any application data (CV, resume) via email. If you want to apply for the SGP or any other position at Siemens, please use the “Apply now” button or go to jobs.siemens.com SiemensGraduateProgram.people_organization@siemens.com Anja, Global Program Manager Related content Finance Excellence Program Realize your ambition and gain all you need to become a CFO of tomorrow. jobs.description: WHO A leading international law firm is seeking an Information Governance Manager for Asia, based in its Hong Kong office. You will report to the firm's UK-based head of records, with weekly calls and some flexibility for US time zones, and work closely with lawyers, paralegals, secretaries and administrative management across the region as well as records colleagues worldwide on firmwide projects. The position is full-time, calls for daily presence in the office, involves light regional travel and the occasional period of overtime. WHAT You will supervise records management operations for the region and the staff who deliver them - assigning work, arranging coverage, recruiting, training and conducting performance reviews. The environment is digital-first: alongside the remaining hardcopy records, the firm has recently completed a firmwide migration to a cloud-based document management system, so you will be driving adoption of electronic recordkeeping across the region's working practices. You will oversee active and inactive records systems and centres, manage transfers to off-site storage vendors, and coordinate matter records both ways for departing and arriving lawyers - including files subject to ethical and confidential screens. Stewardship sits at the heart of the role: running retention and disposition in line with firm policy, preserving records caught by document holds, and contributing to the annual inventory and audit. You will also deliver records management education and orientations for new lawyers and staff, train legal and administrative teams on the document management system, monitor service levels and invoices with outside vendors, track key performance indicators, and report on the programme's health and compliance to leadership. YOU You will bring at least seven years' experience in records and information management, together with a bachelor's degree or equivalent including specialised coursework in records management, business law, administrative management or computer technology. Proficiency in records, document or content management applications is essential, and experience of a document management system migration - particularly a move to cloud storage - is a real plus. A Certified Records Manager (CRM) or Information Governance Professional (IGP) credential, or candidacy for one, is preferred, as is prior team leadership and time spent at a law firm or another professional services firm. Candidates often build this profile in law firm IT or professional support teams, so a technology-comfortable background is welcome. You will need strong interpersonal and written communication skills, confident planning and organisation, the judgement to analyse problems and recommend sound decisions, the self-motivation to work independently, and strong computer and database skills including classification of electronic documents.

From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. Responsibilities Ensuring Premium Luxury Quality (Non-Testing) Define what "premium luxury" means for Quince bedding: consistent hand-feel, uniform dye penetration, breathable yet durable construction, and natural surface character without excessive processing. Develop sensory quality standards: hand-feel benchmarks (buttery, crisp, cool, plush, soft), visual tolerances (weave consistency, slub variation, subtle color variation), and smell (clean, fiber-forward, no chemical odor). Partner with mills to refine finishing processes that enhance perceived value: mercerized cotton that shows natural luster, garment-washed linen for softness, brushed flannel for warmth, and sateen weaves for light-reflective sheen. Benchmark Quince bedding against heritage luxury brands (e.g., Frette, Sferra, Pratesi, Brooklinen) to ensure equal or better hand-feel and visual quality at a fraction of the cost. Lead blind hand-feel panels with design, merchandising, and customer focus groups to validate luxury perception before commercialization. Material Development & Innovation Lead development of exclusive bedding materials: long-staple cottons, European linens, bamboo/Tencel blends, washed silk, down and down-alternative fills, wool, and performance finishes (moisture-wicking, anti-microbial, temperature-regulating). Partner with mills to create seasonal color palettes, surface textures, and hand-feel profiles. Explore and pilot sustainable alternatives (e.g., organic cotton, recycled fibers, bio-based fills, Tencel Lyocell, hemp blends). Develop and qualify new constructions: percale for cool crispness, sateen for silky smoothness, jersey for stretch comfort, waffle for texture, and flannel for warmth. Cost Engineering & Value Analysis Drive cost-down initiatives through yield optimization (e.g., optimizing cut layouts for sheets and duvet covers) and construction efficiency. Analyze cost drivers: fiber origin, yarn spinning method, weave complexity, finishing processes, and waste percentage. Benchmark against competitor materials to ensure equal or better quality at lower cost. Evaluate fill power, thread count, and GSM to optimize performance-to-cost ratios. Technical Specifications (Non-Testing) Define material specs: thread count, yarn size, ply, GSM, weave type, finish type, and color standards (Lab values, ΔE tolerance). Collaborate with design and product development to translate hand-feel and visual expectations into technical briefs for mills. Maintain a master material library with approved references, grade rules, and usage guidelines for design and production teams. Develop specifications for down and down-alternative fills: fill power, fill weight, cluster size, and responsible sourcing certifications (RDS, Downpass). Qualifications Required Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Fashion Merchandising, Supply Chain, or related field. 10+ years in bedding/textile sourcing, development, or merchandising for home goods, apparel, or related categories. Deep knowledge of textile manufacturing processes (weaving, knitting, dyeing, finishing), fiber types, and regional quality differences. Strong cost analysis skills: yield %, waste %, thread count optimization, and landed cost modeling. Experience working with design, production, and sourcing teams in a fast-paced retail environment. Demonstrated experience building and maintaining material libraries, including SKU rationalization and article consolidation. Preferred Familiarity with textile certifications (OEKO-TEX, GOTS, GRS, RDS). Experience with sustainable or alternative bedding materials Knowledge of fiber traceability systems (farm to finished product). Familiarity with PLM systems and material database management. Background in luxury bedding or home textiles (e.g., sheets, duvets, pillows) with an eye for premium aesthetics. WHY QUINCE? jobs.description: 香港錢大媽生鮮食品連鎖有限公司是廣州市錢大媽農產品有限公司旗下連鎖品牌,專營新鮮食材市場,滿足消費者對食材產品的新鮮需求為核心,以「不賣隔夜肉」為經營理念。目前公司經營的品類有肉類、蔬菜、水果、水產、綜合(如雞蛋,粉麵)等五大類別逾500種優質食品,滿足家庭三餐食材需求。在經營管理上,顛覆了傳統農產品流通與銷售模式,店面每天19:00開始打折,每隔半個小時再打低一折,直至免費派送。錢大媽所有門店經營的所有產品均要求當天銷售完畢,決不隔夜銷售,顧客買得放心,吃得安心! 健康生活,從新鮮餐桌開始\-\-\-\-\-錢大媽,不賣隔夜肉。 工作職責 * 負責香港區分店生果品類的採購工作,涵蓋內地供港生果及進口生果兩條貨源線,制訂並執行年度、季度及節慶檔期採購計劃。 * 開發及維護內地供港生果基地與包裝廠資源,核查其海關註冊登記資質,確保貨源符合供港澳水果檢驗檢疫監管要求。 * 開發及維護本港進口生果渠道,包括進口商、代理及批發市場檔口,掌握車厘子、榴槤、提子、柑橘等主要品類的產季、口岸及價格行情。 * 配合折扣日清模式進行精準量控:根據分店客流、天氣、節慶及歷史售罄數據下達訂貨量,將生果損耗及臨期折扣損失控制於目標範圍內。 * 負責供應商談判及合約管理,圍繞到岸價、賬期、退換貨、品質扣罰及缺貨違約金等條款爭取有利條件,並建立後備供應商池以保障供貨連續性。 * 執行到貨驗收及品質把關:現場開箱抽檢、核對規格等級及淨重、查驗植物檢疫證書及出貨清單封識資料,對不合格批次執行拒收及索償。 * 跟進跨境物流及口岸通關節奏,協同倉儲、物流及報關環節,保障生果於冷鏈條件下的時效與鮮度,並處理突發滯港、查驗及天氣中斷等異常情況。 * 參與生果品類結構及選品優化,配合分店 SKU 精簡策略,推動高動銷、高毛利單品及自有品牌生果商品落地。 * 定期走訪分店及同業,收集銷情及價格反饋;輸出採購數據分析報告,為品類經營決策提供依據。 入職要求 * 學士學位或以上,學科不限。 * 2 至 4 年生果採購或生鮮採購相關經驗,曾完整跟過產季並獨立洽談供應商。 * 同時熟悉內地生果及進口生果:了解國內主要產區與上市檔期,亦了解進口生果的准入國家、檢疫要求及到岸成本構成。 * 了解供港澳水果的檢驗檢疫監管要求,包括包裝廠註冊登記、來源果園名錄、出貨清單及運輸封識等具體規定;具供港經驗者顯著優先。 * 持有香港永久性居民身份證,或具備在香港合法受僱之資格。 * 持有有效港澳居民來往內地通行證(回鄉證),或持有可合法往返內地之旅行證件並能配合每月多次往返內地之工作安排。 * 可接受頻繁往返香港與內地出外公幹,並能適應凌晨至清晨的批發市場調研及到貨驗收作業節奏。 * 具一線作業意識及相應體力,可參與卸貨驗收、開箱翻查、搬運抽樣等現場工作,能長時間於冷鏈環境作業。 * 粵語流利,普通話可作日常溝通;具基本英語讀寫能力,可與進口商進行單證及電郵往來。 * 對數據敏感,熟練使用 Excel 完成銷量、損耗、毛利及價格趨勢分析;具採購系統或 ERP 使用經驗優先。 * 職業操守良好,能嚴格遵守公司採購廉潔規定,無供應商利益輸送記錄;抗壓能力強,做事勤快踏實、執行力佳。 優先考慮 * 具社區生鮮、連鎖超市、生鮮電商或生果專業連鎖的採購經驗,理解高周轉與低損耗的經營邏輯。 * 熟悉文錦渡等供港口岸的通關流程及作業時間窗,曾實際處理滯港及查驗異常。 * 熟悉本港批發市場及果欄渠道,具現成供應商人脈,可即時開展本地補貨與調貨。 * 具榴槤、車厘子等高單價、高損耗風險單品的產季採購及虧損控制實戰案例。 * 具供應商開發從零到一的經歷,能獨立搭建區域貨源網絡。 有意者请点击“立即申请”,提交完整简历及现任及预期薪资。 我们是一个机会均等的雇主。 收到的所有信息将严格保密,仅用于与就业相关的目的。

jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region - this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for a Lead Recruiter (Commercial & Corporate Hiring) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally. This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth. You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business. What You’ll Do Business Recruitment Leadership Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions. Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies. Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends. Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions. Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber passive candidates in competitive talent markets. Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across key business functions to support both current and future hiring needs. Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets. Develop strong understanding of global labor markets, compensation trends, and talent availability across multiple countries. Team Development & Process Excellence Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management capabilities. Establish recruiting best practices, interview calibration standards, sourcing frameworks, and hiring processes across business functions. Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement. Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team. Recruitment Operations & Reporting Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting. Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality. Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages. Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions. The Right Fit Has 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience across multiple business and corporate functions. Proven success recruiting for functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, Consulting, CEO Office, or other business-critical roles. Demonstrated ability to hire senior, niche, and difficult-to-fill positions across multiple markets. Strong expertise in sourcing passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, talent mapping, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques. Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence hiring decisions and challenge hiring assumptions when necessary. Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, organizational design discussions, and workforce planning initiatives. Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred. Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries. Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics. Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills. Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, consulting firms, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred. What Success Looks Like Consistently delivers high-quality hires across multiple business functions and regions. Builds sustainable talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill business roles. Becomes a trusted advisor to business leaders and hiring managers. Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience. Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership. Why Join BJAK Above-market remuneration. Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities. High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth. Exposure to global hiring across multiple countries and functions. Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership on critical business hiring initiatives. Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles. Meaningful work that directly contributes to building and scaling world-class teams.

jobs.description: About Ropes & Gray Ropes & Gray is a preeminent global law firm. The firm has been ranked in the top three on The American Lawyer's prestigious A-List for eight consecutive years and #1 on Law.com's UK A-List twice in the past three years - rankings that honor the "best of the best" law firms. The firm has approximately 2,500 lawyers and professionals serving clients in major centers of business, finance, technology, and government in Boston, Chicago, Dublin, Hong Kong, London, Los Angeles, Milan, New York, Paris, San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, Silicon Valley, Singapore, Tokyo and Washington, D.C.The firm has consistently been recognized for its leading practices in many areas, including asset management, private equity, M&A, finance, real estate, tax, antitrust, life sciences, health care, intellectual property, litigation & enforcement, privacy & cybersecurity, and business restructuring. Ropes & Gray is an equal opportunity employer. Overview The Senior Information Governance Technology Analyst is the department subject matter expert in records management technology, network drive use and metrics, general information technology, and serves as the primary point of contact in their region for other IS technology and administrative departments. The Senior Information Governance Technology Analyst works closely with colleagues within IG and other IS departments to provide sound and efficient delivery of records management products and services to our internal and external clients. The Senior Information Governance Technology Analyst will provide recommendations to the Senior Manager of Information Governance and the Director of Information Governance and Library Services on the procurement of new technology and the use of existing technology. The support team member will lead and manage key IG projects involving technology-based solutions. The support team member will foster support for the adoption of new technology in their local region, including serving as a support and training resource for key artificial intelligence tool adoption. The Senior Information Governance Technology Analyst will delegate project work and assignments to other IG team members, working closely with IG management on resource assignments and bandwidth of team members. This position will be responsible for international regional Information Governance support. Responsibilities Liaise with the Manager of Information Governance Mobility to assist in the coordination and oversight of the transfer-in and transfer-out of client documents. Review and approve requested client materials in accordance with IG and OGC processes and procedures. Assist the Manager of Information Governance Mobility with technical work related to outgoing and incoming client file transfers. This includes creating and importing PSTs and ensuring proper formatting of documents imported/exported to and from other law firms and clients. As required, take the lead on support for incoming client transfers for international offices including but not limited to organizing and importing PSTs, organizing, and importing documents into iManage Work, documenting the process of each, and providing process training to additional resources. Work with Enterprise Systems (ES) to use desktop import tools to perform document migration jobs. Meet with content owners, define requirements, and ensure accurate and seamless migration of content. As required, be a key resource for POCs for new desktop import tools, testing, and making sound recommendations for tool selection and implementation. Create, edit, and track physical records in IRM, the firm’s records management system. Provide training to end users to facilitate label creation and the proper maintenance and disposition of physical records. Identify needed reports and submit requests to ES for custom reports from iRM to capture metrics on core records management functions such as file creation, requests, re-files, transfers, and destruction. Support the Manager of Information Governance in managing the off-site storage relationship with international regional records management vendors and assist with invoice tracking and payment and budgeting, as needed. Serve as the local contact for local vendors in international regional offices, recalling records from offsite storage as needed, sending records offsite, and general maintenance of in office and offsite inventory. Liaise with the Senior Information Governance Disposition Specialist to assist with international regional record retention and disposition. Provide coverage for Information Governance Jira tickets during the local time zone as well as off hours upon request for coverage from IG Management. Handle Information Governance Jira tickets including but not limited to O: drive requests, H: drive requests, C: drive requests, Box, and other collaboration tool related tickets. May also handle tickets that support the firm’s technology exception processes, such as the use of real time chat, uploads to cloud services, or saving to removable media With department leadership, support unusual activity monitoring and data prevention efforts and incidents in the region. Lead the effort of the H: drive quota system, addressing end user questions and needs, assisting with local document organization and imports into iManage, educating users on best practices for H: drive management. On-board IG team members to handle H: drive issues for end users in their local offices. Support the transition from H: network drives for end users to firm wide-use of OneDrive. Serve as a key resource for testing, end-user training, and migration of files from individual H: drives to OneDrive. Working closely with Desktop Engineering, develop methods for scanning end user C: drives. Proactively reach out to end users to have them move content off their C: drives. Educate end users on the firm and client risks when storing data on C: drives. Develop methods for regular scanning, monitoring, and end user reach outs. On-board IG team members to handle C: drive issues for end users in their local offices. Provide assistance to the Senior Manager of Information Governance to implement and maintain tools and processes for capturing metrics related to iManage Work and be able to provide reports to IG management on meaningful parameters of use. Work with others in IG to integrate content stored in iManage Work into the firm’s records management system. Provide support to IG and Enterprise Systems (ES) to integrate iManage Work content with other commercial and custom applications as appropriate. Define requirements for Litigation Technology team to leverage technology assisted review tools such as Relativity for outgoing file transfer and file destruction functions. Work with IG management and Enterprise Systems to evaluate IG products and make recommendations for upgrades or purchasing new technology. Be actively involved in online forums and user groups for IRM, iManage Work, and iRM, and for document and records management as a field of expertise. Collaborate across IS departments to ensure technology already in place in the environment is being utilized to its full capacity. Explore ways in which existing and new technologies can streamline and/or automate business processes. Support new firm technology proof of concept pilots, early adopter programs, and firm-wide rollouts, particularly AI-related tools, through testing, pilot group participation, feedback cycles, end user support and training. Learn the technology use cases and make recommendations to lawyers and business support team members as to which tool(s) may best fit their needs. Manage IG department projects upon request, defining project scope, requirements, resources, timelines, and goals. Delegate project tasks. Facilitate project meetings. Provide regular status updates to IG management. Identify risks and work with IG management to mitigate risks. Provide analysis, support and training to attorneys, paralegals and secretaries on document and email management best practices and procedures. Work individually with end users to organize email folders and link to a workspace, as appropriate. Create and promote a program of IG best practices, tying together iManage Work and network drive compliance requirements and acceptable use for storing and sharing firm data. Coordinate with Office Administrators, IS Secretarial Services management and Paralegal management for opportunities to educate their teams on a regular basis. Support the Office Managing Partner with Information Governance related needs for the office. Provide iManage Work training to new joiners in the international regional offices. Collaborate with the IT Training team to align on content and training materials. Mentor team members by expanding their skillset in Information Governance operations tasks and workflows. Coordinate with their manager on assignments, priorities, and workload. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in MIS, Information Services, Records & Information Management or related field required. Five to seven years of law firm experience in records or document management, information services, knowledge management, or legal technology required. Proficient user knowledge of iManage Work strongly preferred. Proficient user knowledge of iRM strongly preferred. Proven technical skills strongly preferred including basic knowledge of document/folder metadata and basic security principles. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required. Advanced Microsoft Outlook skills required. Proficient user knowledge of Microsoft Teams, OneNote, OneDrive, and Co-pilot desirable. Basic knowledge of SQL reporting preferred. Strong business analysis and project management skills. Experience in technical training desirable. Ability to work with a variety of people at all levels within the organization. Exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent customer service orientation, positive, proactive manner. Must have strong written and oral communication skills and be able to explain concepts and provide direction to all levels of staff and attorneys. Solid presentation skills important. Ability to organize, plan and carry out multiple projects simultaneously. Must be both a self-starter and a team player. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision required. Compensation and Total Rewards Package Ropes & Gray is proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package to our business support team members. The firm also offers comprehensive health and well-being benefits, personal and professional development, career growth opportunities and a collegial and supportive culture. In addition, this role is eligible for a discretionary bonus based on performance. The actual offered rate for this position will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data and consideration of internal equity. Working Conditions Standard office schedule is onsite five days per week. Work schedule is 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM in Hong Kong and 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM in Tokyo but must be available evenings and weekends as required. Travel, as required. The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements.

Each brand embraces its unique identity to excel within a highly competitive global landscape. Our approach to investing is scientific: we bring together data, research, technology and trading expertise to develop and run systematic strategies. Technology is central to how QRT works. Over the years, we have built a global research and execution platform spanning geographies, asset classes and trading horizons, from ultra-low-latency systems to large-scale research, analytics and risk infrastructure. We invest heavily in engineering, automation and scalable systems because better technology allows us to test ideas faster, operate more reliably and tackle harder problems. Our internships are designed to give students meaningful experience of that work. You’ll join a team, contribute to real projects and learn from engineers, researchers and traders working on live problems. The environment is technical, collaborative and demanding, with plenty of scope to ask questions, test ideas and take ownership. Strong performance during the internship may lead to consideration for a full-time graduate role. Your future role at QRT Throughout the recruitment process, we’ll consider your skills and interests alongside the problems our teams are working on, with the aim of finding the strongest fit. QRT’s FPGA team builds ultra-low-latency hardware for our trading systems. By implementing custom logic directly on FPGA devices, the team can process market data and execute orders with tight control over latency, throughput and system behaviour. The work sits at the boundary between hardware and software. We use SystemVerilog, C++ and Python to design, verify and integrate FPGA systems into our wider trading infrastructure. The problems are technically demanding: small design decisions can have measurable consequences, and performance needs to come with reliability. As an intern or graduate in the FPGA team, you will: Build production FPGA systems - Contribute to the design, development and optimisation of FPGA-based platforms used in live trading. Work across hardware and software - Use SystemVerilog, C++ and Python to build, test and refine high-performance, low-latency systems. Develop and verify new functionality - Implement FPGA features that improve how our systems process market data and execute orders, and build the tests needed to verify them. Integrate systems - Work with hardware and software engineers to connect FPGA components with QRT’s broader trading infrastructure. Analyse performance - Debug and profile designs, investigating latency, resource utilisation and other constraints to understand where improvements can be made. Work with modern FPGA technology - Gain hands-on experience with FPGA hardware, development tools and verification workflows used in low-latency trading. Explore new approaches - Contribute to research and development aimed at improving the performance and capabilities of our FPGA systems. Your present skillset Interest in technology: You enjoy understanding how systems work and have explored that interest through software or hardware projects, whether academic, personal or hobby-based. Formal Computer Science training is not essential. HDL experience: Experience or coursework using an HDL such as SystemVerilog, Verilog or VHDL. Programming: Experience with C++ and/or Python. Technical foundations: An understanding of digital logic design, computer architecture and high-speed interfaces. FPGA tools: Familiarity with FPGA development toolchains such as Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus is useful, but not essential. Problem solving: You can reason through technical problems methodically, troubleshoot designs and think about trade-offs between performance, resource utilisation and power efficiency. Mindset: Curious, proactive and comfortable asking questions. You look for opportunities to understand systems more deeply and improve how they perform. Approach: Self-motivated, thoughtful and comfortable taking ownership of a problem. Interviewing Application - Submit your application online. We review applications on a rolling basis, so applying early is recommended. Technical Assessment - Selected candi dat es will complete a technical interview with the relevant team . Interviews - Shortlisted candidates will take part in interviews, either on-site or via Microsoft Teams. We’ll explore your technical foundations, how you reason through engineering problems and how you work with others. QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.
