As a core vehicle for Noah’s AI strategy and a specialist in global asset allocation, Olive maintains deep ties with asset managers and capital markets worldwide. Olive operates across **Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, and the U.S.** , supported by a global research network spanning **Mainland China, Hong Kong, the U.S., Singapore, Japan, and Canada** . We focus on **alternative investments, private equity, hedge funds, U.S. direct investments** , and diversified multi\-asset solutions for the AI era. We manage portfolios through a disciplined **“Safety, Core, Growth”** framework. Since 2016, Olive has built one of Asia’s earliest and most systematic strategic positions in **AI infrastructure** , with exposure to **200\+ AI and frontier technology companies** through **50\+ venture capital sub\-funds** and **100\+ direct investments** . As of **December 31, 2025** , Noah Holdings-through subsidiaries including **ARK, Gopher Asset Management, and Olive Asset Management** -managed nearly **USD 30 billion** in onshore and offshore advisory and custodial assets. **Olive Asset Management** 是 **诺亚控股** ( **Noah Holdings,NYSE: NOAH;HKEX: 6686** )旗下的 **全球资产管理平台** 。诺亚控股是服务全球华语高净值及超高净值客户的领先财富与资产管理机构。作为诺亚 **AI 战略的核心载体** 及全球资产配置专家,Olive 与全球资管机构和资本市场保持深度联结。 Olive 在 **香港、新加坡、日本和美国** 设有核心运营布局,并依托覆盖 **中国内地、香港、美国、新加坡、日本和加拿大** 的全球研究网络,聚焦 **另类投资、私募股权、对冲基金、美国直接投资** 及面向 AI 时代的多资产配置解决方案。 我们采用严谨的 **“安全、核心、增长”** 三层投资框架。自 2016 年起,Olive 已构建亚洲较早且系统化的 **AI 基础设施投资布局** ,通过 **50\+ 支 VC 子基金** 与 **100\+ 笔直接投资** ,累计覆盖 **200\+ 家 AI 及前沿科技企业** 。 截至 **2025 年 12 月 31 日** ,诺亚控股通过 **ARK、歌斐资产管理、Olive Asset Management** 等子公司管理的境内外投顾与托管资产合计近 **300 亿美元** 。 **What You’ll Do \| 你将参与** * Develop a structured understanding of global asset classes, market cycles, and investment products, including funds, fixed income, equities, alternatives, and multi\-asset strategies. * 系统建立对全球大类资产、市场周期及投资产品的认知,包括基金、固收、股票、另类及多资产策略等。 * Support market research, product due diligence, manager/fund screening, peer analysis, and ongoing monitoring; turn complex information into clear investment insights. * 参与市场研究、产品尽调、管理人/基金筛选、同业比较及存续跟踪,并将复杂信息转化为清晰的投资洞察。 * Assist in building portfolio ideas, asset allocation views, and product solution proposals based on return objectives, risk budgets, and liquidity needs. * 围绕收益目标、风险预算及流动性需求,协助形成组合思路、资产配置观点及产品解决方案。 * Work closely with Noah’s wealth management and advisory teams to translate investment views into clear, client\-relevant materials and solution narratives. * 与诺亚财富管理及顾问团队紧密合作,将投资观点转化为清晰、贴近客户需求的材料与解决方案表达。 * Prepare investment presentations, factsheets, quarterly reviews, and performance summaries; leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency, visualization, and communication quality. * 协助制作投资路演材料、产品说明、季度回顾及业绩总结,并善用 AI 工具提升研究效率、可视化表达与沟通质量。 * Participate in investment meetings, product discussions, and selected client communications under mentor guidance, gradually growing toward roles in investment solutions, product strategy, or specialist tracks. * 在导师带领下参与投研会议、产品讨论及部分客户沟通,逐步成长为投资解决方案、产品策略或专业型岗位人才。 * Take part in cross\-team projects and, where relevant, rotational exposure across research, product, and client solutions to build an end\-to\-end understanding of the asset management business. * 参与跨团队项目,并根据业务安排获得研究、产品、客户解决方案等方向的学习或轮岗机会,建立对资产管理全链条的理解。 **Who We’re Looking For \| 我们希望你是** * Graduates from the **Class of 2026 or 2027** ; both **Bachelor’s and Master’s** candidates are welcome to apply. * **2026 或 2027 届** 本科及硕士毕业生,均可申请。 * Preferred majors include **Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering** , or related disciplines. * 专业优先包括 **金融、经济、商科、数学、统计、数据科学、计算机、工程** 或相关方向。 * Strong curiosity about **capital markets, investing, and asset management** ; internship experience in asset management, research, banking, consulting, fintech, or related fields is a plus. * 对 **资本市场、投资与资产管理** 有强烈兴趣;有资管、研究、银行、咨询、金融科技等相关实习经历更佳。 * Strong logical thinking, analytical rigor, structured problem\-solving ability, and fast learning capability. * 具备清晰的逻辑思维、扎实的分析能力、结构化解决问题能力,以及快速学习能力。 * Hands\-on experience using **AI tools** , with the ability to apply them to research, workflow automation, communication, or visualization. * 有实际使用 **AI 工具** 的经验,能够将其应用于研究、流程提效、沟通表达或可视化场景。 * Proficient in **Excel and PowerPoint** ; familiarity with **Python, Bloomberg, Wind, Morningstar** , or other data tools is a plus. * 熟练使用 **Excel、PowerPoint** ;如会 **Python、Bloomberg、Wind、Morningstar** 或其他数据工具更佳。 * Fluent in **English and Mandarin Chinese** ; **Cantonese or other foreign languages** are a plus. * 具备良好的 **英文和普通话** 沟通能力;会 **粤语或其他外语** 更佳。 * Strong communication skills, maturity, ownership, and the willingness to build a long\-term career in asset management and investment solutions. * 具备优秀的沟通能力、成熟度和责任感,并愿意在资产管理及投资解决方案方向长期发展。 **What You’ll Gain \| 你将获得** * A structured early\-career program with close mentorship from senior investors and business leaders. * 系统化的早期职业培养机制,以及来自资深投资人和业务管理者的直接指导。 * Real exposure to markets, products, and client solution work from day one - not just coordination or support tasks. * 从第一天起接触真实的市场、产品与客户解决方案工作,而不仅仅是协调或支持型任务。 * A Hong Kong\-based, globally oriented platform within Noah Holdings. * 依托诺亚控股、立足香港、面向全球的职业发展平台。 * A strong foundation for future opportunities across investment solutions, product management, research, and broader Noah businesses. * 为未来在投资解决方案、产品管理、研究及诺亚更广阔业务平台上的发展打下坚实基础。 **Equal Opportunity \| 平等就业机会** Olive Asset Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Olive Asset Management 致力于为所有候选人及员工提供 **公平、平等的职业机会** 。我们的招聘与用人决策基于候选人的能力、经验、发展潜力及业务需要,不因种族、肤色、宗教、性别、性别认同或表达、性取向、国籍、年龄、残障、婚姻状况、怀孕、退伍军人身份或任何适用法律保护的身份而产生歧视。 **How to Apply \| 申请方式** Please apply via LinkedIn with your **English CV** . 欢迎通过 LinkedIn 投递,并附上 **英文简历** 。

jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.note: FreeHire 完整职位说明；地点和岗位类型由本站再次核对。
jobs.description: Position Summary The Associates are expected to work pro-actively and efficiently on multiple client engagements through the combination of solid project management skills, proactive and quality search execution, ownership mentality and strong, team-oriented delivery to specific client needs. Each assignment is driven by a team, including at a minimum a Consultant, Associate and Executive Assistant. There are times when an Associate may be working with multiple team members located in different geographies. Executive Search : Skill sets include strong communication and assessment abilities applied to evaluating business experience and professional competencies of top executive talent as they relate to a client’s specific need. Successful candidates for the Associate position will also have project management ability, results orientation, rigorous attention to details, intellectual curiosity and enjoy the challenge of working internally with a variety of consultants, and externally with diverse, senior-level executives and board members. Associates will be expected to acquire deep and insightful candidate pool knowledge over time which would be related to a specific industry, function or geography. KEY RELATIONSHIPS Reports to Research Director, Greater China Consultants (on assignment/ engagement basis) Other key relationships Office Manager Practice Leader/ Practice Members Consultants Research Team Executive Assistant Team KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Contribute actively to the start-up phase of the search by participating in client kick-off meetings with the Consultant(s) and assisting in the development of the search strategy and target list of companies. As appropriate contribute to winning client pitches by providing benchmark candidate profiles and other background information. Assist Consultants in completing the HKEX board index, supporting research, data compilation, and validation of relevant board-level information. Gather relevant information regarding the appropriate industries and target companies, including identifying potential prospects and sources. Represent client effectively in the marketplace and present a comprehensive universe of qualified candidates by partnering with the Consultant(s) and observing aspects of confidentiality throughout the search process. Anticipate needs to drive the search to closure and be prepared to supply additional information, such as related industry trends, market findings, reaction to the opportunity, compensation data, etc., gained during the course of a search. Communicate effectively with the search team, including Consultant(s), other Associates/Senior Associates and Executive Assistant(s) and remain fully abreast of search developments in order to communicate accurately and credibly regarding the assignment. Prepare organized information for the client progress report/meeting by teaming with the Consultant(s) and the Executive Assistant(s). Provide an informed perspective on prospects/candidates and how they line up against the key selection criteria outlined by the client. Ensure up to date assignment, company and candidate information during the course of an assignment is always available for colleagues, by leveraging technology and information from the Firm’s state-of- the-art, proprietary database (Quest), recording all relevant candidate details using the Initial Assessment function. Be aware of activities and changes in general business and in the industry/functional areas where specialized. Add to the Firm’s knowledge by identifying and beginning to develop expertise in a defined industry, functional or geographic candidate pool. Be willing and proactive about contributing to local, practice or Firm-wide initiatives. Coordinate and share practice related information to the KM for potentially broader distribution, participate in practice calls and meetings as appropriate. Adopt and adhere diligently to Firm policies and standards for candidate validation, documentation and assessment as well as demonstrating professional behaviour and living our values (including adherence to Red Book, Quest policies etc.) Candidate Profile IDEAL EXPERIENCE A minimum of 5 years of experience In a relevant executive search, leadership advisory or strategy consulting environment, or corporate Human Resources Management with a focus on organizational development and/or organizational culture consulting, and/or a role where multiple projects and competing demands are the norm. Domain or Subject Matter Expertise Domain expertise in an industry or functional area would be helpful. Prior experience related to the application and interpretation of psychometric instruments will be highly advantageous. International International mindset and ideally will have experience in working across borders. Language Fluency in English (written and spoken) and Cantonese (spoken); additional language skills will be an advantage, particularly in markets where the knowledge of one or more of the national languages is important. University Graduate Bachelor’s Degree required. Advanced degree is preferable. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES Project Management: Plans, manages and drives own efforts to identify and develop a slate of quality candidates as measured by consultant, client and candidate feedback. The successful Associate will do this while handling multiple projects with competing deadlines, working with individuals who have differing styles, and managing challenging expectations: Takes an end-to-end view of each project and the required resources; works at pace and with attention to detail while managing competing deadlines and priorities; has a sense of urgency. Understands the search process (from internal kick-off to referencing); asks questions to understand; and is proactive. Works on multiple projects; meets deadlines and is resilient under pressure; delivers on commitments on time or notifies as early as possible if deadlines will slip. Demonstrates enthusiasm, tenacity and intellectual curiosity; action-oriented; deals with problems immediately. Is results focused and flexible; demonstrates a strong work ethic. Candidate Development Develop qualified and interested candidates for portfolio of searches. A successful Associate will develop excellence in search strategy to build strong contact management lists: Observe and ask questions to fully understand the issue; synthesize information from a variety of internal/external sources, despite possibly having ambiguous or incomplete information. Gather relevant data from a variety of sources, including views gathered through Third Party Sourcing (TPS), to help determine broad capabilities, gaps, qualifications/fit; articulate reasons for fit to spec in a succinct manner. Determine priority of which potential candidates to approach. Add meaningful notes on Quest, diligently uses the initial assessment feature. Credibility and Influence Communicates effectively both in writing and verbally; has "gravitas" (executive presence) and is able to build relationships. Able to hook candidates and convince consultants to meet them, building a strong internal brand: Interacts with a range of internal and external stakeholders and candidates with differing styles and egos, understanding and appreciating what is important to each. Becomes a credible and authentic professional by observing colleagues and emulating role models. Adapts verbal and written communications according to expectations for role and audience, specifically how to be confident, succinct, concise, prepared and professional. Market and Candidate Knowledge Obtains and incorporates knowledge to enhance client work in a meaningful way. Knows how to get information, effectively uses the available firm resources, developing and sharing candidate pool knowledge: Identifies executive movements in the market and updates Quest (ideally in real time) and colleagues; asks questions and shows interest in networking. Has a genuine interest in/curiosity about people and businesses; and has an understanding of businesses and their interrelationships. Understands how to identify and navigate the various relevant sources available (Quest, Passport, Global Information Services, Hoovers, LinkedIn, etc). PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS High in curiosity and learning. Strong adaptability to working with a range of clients and colleagues with differing styles, adjusting communications and approach. Strong organisation and prioritisation abilities. Discretion and sensitivity in dealing with confidential communications and documentation. Endurance and the ability to handle multiple conflicting priorities at once. Solid judgement. Having the ability to make sound decisions and work autonomously in the absence of constant supervision. Proactive and takes steps to prevent problems before they occur.

jobs.description: IM8 is a next-generation health and longevity brand co-founded by David Beckham and Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE), on a mission to make world-class nutritional science accessible to everyone. Over 60% of revenue is generated outside the US. We ship to 43 countries, and our athlete partner roster includes David Beckham, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aryna Sabalenka, Ollie Bearman, and Inter Miami CF. We are built on science, not story - our flagship Daily Ultimate Essentials carries 90 active ingredients, we run randomized controlled trials on our products, and we hold a clinical-grade standard in a category notorious for shortcuts. Our business is subscription at its core. Every basis point of NRR we add compounds - into LTV, into payback, into the ability to outspend everyone else on acquisition. Retention isn't a department at IM8. It is the model. Why This Role Is Different Most media buying roles inherit a messy account and spend years cleaning up someone else's logic. This one doesn't. At our growth rate, paid social has to scale faster than the rest of the business or it becomes the bottleneck on everything - new markets, new products, new athletes. Every wasted dollar of spend is a dollar not compounding into customer lifetime value, and on a subscription model with the LTV we're building, sloppy buying compounds against you fast. This account is already run as a rules-based system - spend frontiers per lane, kill limits, scaling ceilings, pause-don't-delete discipline, mandatory change logging, daily diagnostics. We need someone who treats a Meta account as a brand growth asset with real operating discipline, not a dashboard to babysit. The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior Media Buyer - IM8 Health, based in Hong Kong, to own day-to-day buying on a Meta account on track for $10M/month in spend, reporting to the VP of Growth. Thousands of live ads, multiple prospecting lanes, one explicit rules-based system that you run, improve, and answer for. Your mandate: own blended new-customer CAC against Shopify as the source of truth - not platform-attributed numbers - and make every buying decision legible, logged, and defensible. What You'll Do Own campaign architecture at scale Structure campaigns and ad sets across multiple prospecting lanes, making deliberate CBO vs ABO calls Run testing pods with spend floors and allocate budget across lanes with known efficiency ceilings Execute daily buying under a rules-based system Make daily launches, kills, scales, and budget moves under pre-agreed thresholds and triggers Name, reason, and log every change so the account is legible to someone who didn't build it Run structured creative testing Get new concepts to valid spend levels and protect tests from delivery concentration Distinguish creative failures from configuration failures - bid strategy, exclusions, broken destinations Scale winners without breaking them Scale without resetting the learning phase; manage the interplay of budget velocity, CPM inflation, and audience saturation Cross-check Meta attribution against Shopify daily and make kill/scale calls on matured, full-day blended CAC Partner and expand Work with the creative team on pipeline velocity, flagging creative age and fatigue on major lanes before performance shows it Contribute to expansion on secondary channels as we scale beyond Meta What We're Looking For 3-5 years of hands-on paid social media buying DTC / e-commerce fluency: you understand CAC, LTV, contribution margin, and the gap between platform ROAS and blended reality Deep working knowledge of Meta mechanics: learning phase behaviour, delivery concentration within ad sets, bid strategies (cost caps, tROAS) and their failure modes, attribution windows and maturation Rigorous operating habits: change logs, naming conventions, threshold-based decisions - not vibes Based in Hong Kong or willing to relocate Non-Negotiable You have personally structured, scaled, and been accountable for $10M+/year in Meta ad spend - not reported on it, owned it - or a clear, specific reason why that benchmark doesn't apply to your trajectory. If you can't make that case in a sentence, this isn't your role. Nice to Have Buying experience on AppLovin and/or TikTok Ads Subscription-business and retention-aware acquisition experience Health, wellness, or supplements experience You Must Be AI-Native Active, fluent daily AI tool usage is mandatory, not optional. We expect you to be embedding AI into every workflow you touch on day one. Beat Claude Challenge Shortlisted candidates complete a role-specific assignment, scored against a baseline we generate using Claude - same data, blind review. It covers account build, buying rules, and live diagnosis of a broken account snapshot. We care about judgment under real constraints, not portfolio decks. To advance, your thinking needs to be better than what the best AI produces. Ties don't advance. Want to stand out? Head to our GitHub repo and submit your Beat Claude challenge: https://github.com/Prenetics/beat-claude

jobs.description: About Us IDX Games is looking for a Software Developer to grow our development team. As a Software Developer, you will be involved in developing our product using AI centric tools like Claude, Codex, Cursor, etc. You will work together with project managers, UX/UI designers, business / product team to create world-class gaming products for the casino / gaming industry. About this Role: We are not looking for developers who use AI as a sidekick for autocomplete. We operate a fully AI-driven, high-performance engineering pipeline . In our team, code generation is cheap-judgment, architecture, and intent are the actual work. We expect our developers to operate at a high-output, elite technical standard: thinking deeply about business intent, directing AI agents to execute, and rigorously verifying the results before they hit production. How We View Roles: We do not categorize our developers into traditional, siloed titles like frontend, backend, full stack, DevOps, or QA. Instead, we are an AI-forward team composed of: Builders / Prototypers: Fast execution to bring initial product intent to life. Growers / Scalers: Architecting and expanding features to handle production load. Maintainers: Ensuring long-term system stability, reliability, and security. Perfectors: Polishing UX, performance, and fine-tuning details. We operate as a unified engineering unit using AI to build the best products and solutions possible. How We Work (No Agile Bureaucracy): We run sprints, but we do not run traditional Agile. No stories, no effort points, no backlog grooming marathons. We use Intent-Driven Development (IDD) . You are given high-level product intent and specification plans. You own the execution path from architectural design to deployment. But you are never the lone executor, other team members is there to help. You will spend less time in status meetings and more time orchestrating specs, building harnesses, and shipping production systems. Key Responsibilities: Drive Product Intent: Translate high-level business goals into precise spec plans and execution prompts for AI agents. Orchestrate & Verify: Direct AI workflows to generate code rapidly while rigorously auditing outputs for edge cases, missing assertions, and security flaws. Ship End-to-End Features: Build and maintain scalable backend and frontend services (Godot, Go, PostgreSQL, REST, WebSockets). Own Quality Control: Design the constraints, types, and test harnesses that make high-volume code generation safe at scale. What We Are Looking For: Beyond-Coding Mindset: You focus on product architecture and underlying intent rather than typing lines of code manually. High-Performance Execution: You thrive in an environment where output and velocity are significantly higher than traditional software dev studio. Relentless Verification: You know the failure modes of generated code (hallucinated endpoints, swallowed errors, race conditions) and catch them before QA does. Even better if you can create QA loop to AI engineering those condition out of the development process. Fast Adaptability: You learn new frameworks, codebases, or languages in days, not months. Tech Requirements & Experience: 3+ years of production software development experience (Any core stack). Strong working knowledge of REST, WebSockets, Kafka, Database, Linux CLI, and Git. Active, daily reliance on advanced AI tools for complex production tasks. Familiar with modern software architecture, software security policy and the underlying technologies (ie: SSL/TLS, JWT, Modern Auth & Token Lifecycle, AES Encryption, etc) Bonus (Not required): Experience with Godot, Go, PostgreSQL, C++, or regulated gaming/casino systems. What We Don't Care About: Computer Science Degrees: If you have one, great, but it is not a strict requirement. If you do hold a degree, we prefer a background in Software Engineering or Business Analytics -people who can quickly understand business processes and high-level software architecture. Prior Engine Experience: If you ramp up fast, you will learn our specific game tools and engine immediately. Generic Code Portfolios: We don't care about your previous generic code portfolio. We care much more about your AI orchestration artifacts-show us your AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, custom prompts, execution loops, or custom skills/tools you’ve crafted for your AI coding IDE. Company Culture & Environment: We are a young, fast-paced software team that consistently punches above our weight in the industry. We thrive on challenging the status quo, moving fast, and breaking through traditional development bottlenecks. We offer a fun, open, and transparent work environment where direct technical debate is encouraged, hierarchy is minimal, and shipping great products is the top priority. Benefits & Office Perks: Competitive compensation & annual leave scheme. 5-day work week with flexible hours. Flat structure with minimal bureaucracy and zero micromanagement. Stocked pantry with free snacks and drinks . Office game area with a pool table and arcade games . Company medical scheme (post-probation). How to Apply: Submit your application at with: GitHub Profile or code repository access (including your AI IDE setup/rules files if applicable, e.g., AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md). Expected Salary. A Half Page to One Page Case Study: Describe a production feature where you relied heavily on AI code generation. Detail what you asked for, what the model got wrong, what you rejected, and how you verified the final output. Resume: This will primarily be used to verify your previous employment background rather than grading traditional skill keywords. Don't just click submit your resume as your application, without any effort, your application will automatically be throw into the recycle bin. Equal Opportunities We’re an Equal Opportunities Employer. We believe in giving everyone the same opportunities for employment, pay, and promotion, without discrimination. Your gender, race, religion, sexual orientation or whether or not you’re a Star Wars fan or a Star Trek fan has no bearing on your path for opportunities at our companies. All applications will be treated in strict confidence and will be used for recruitment purposes only. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.description: Animoca Brands Corporation Limited (ACN: 122 921 813) is a Web3 leader that leverages tokenization and blockchain to deliver digital property rights to consumers, helping to establish the open metaverse and its associated network effects. Animoca Brands realizes its mission via three integrated business pillars: operating Web3 businesses to advance blockchain adoption with native projects such as Moca Network , Anichess , The Sandbox , Open Campus , NEOM Web3 initiatives, and a regulated stablecoin project in partnership with Standard Chartered and HKT; providing digital asset advisory services including tokenomics advisory, liquidity provisioning, and institutional research to help external Web3 projects grow; and investment management , with a portfolio of investments in over 540 companies including industry leaders Pudgy Penguins, Yuga Labs, Axie Infinity, Polygon, Consensys, Magic Eden, OpenSea, Dapper Labs, YGG, and many others. Develop, implement, and maintain robust internal controls and group reporting processes to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and compliance, particularly in relation to digital asset management and revenue recognition from gaming and blockchain activities. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior finance team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development in a high-growth, innovative environment. jobs.description: **Help build the intelligence layer for Asia’s AI infrastructure** A\-Field Tech Limited is a Hong Kong\-based AI and network infrastructure company. NexLLM is a Hong Kong\-based AI infrastructure company building a stable and secure regional gateway for developers who need reliable access to leading AI models. Our live platform provides developers with OpenAI\-compatible APIs across a growing catalogue of models, including Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, and DeepSeek. We are now developing the next layer: intelligent model routing, model evaluation, reliability tooling, and developer infrastructure that helps applications choose and operate the right model for each task. We are looking for a **full\-time AI R\&D Engineering Intern** to join our engineering team. This internship is designed for a university student who wants practical experience working on real AI infrastructure, applied research, and software engineering problems. You will work closely with the founder and engineering team on projects that affect a live platform. This is not a purely observational internship or a role limited to administrative tasks. You will be expected to learn quickly, build working prototypes, measure results, and contribute to production improvements with appropriate guidance. **Internship details** * Role: AI R\&D Engineering Intern * Commitment: Full\-time internship * Location: Hong Kong / flexible hybrid arrangement * Company: NexLLM * Team: AI infrastructure, model routing, evaluation, and platform engineering * Duration: To be agreed based on the university programme and candidate’s availability * Start date: Flexible, subject to mutual agreement **What You May Work On** Your projects will be selected according to your skills, learning goals, and NexLLM’s current priorities. Possible areas include: * Researching and prototyping model\-routing strategies * Comparing models across quality, cost, latency, availability, and reliability * Building benchmark datasets and reproducible evaluation tools * Developing fallback, retry, timeout, caching, and quota\-management features * Investigating provider errors, rate limits, response formats, and performance changes * Integrating new model providers and standardising their APIs and capabilities * Building scripts, dashboards, data pipelines, and internal developer tools * Reviewing relevant papers, technical documentation, and open\-source projects * Turning validated experiments into well\-tested product features * Writing clear technical notes explaining methods, results, limitations, and recommendations The work may involve Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, HTTP APIs, databases, asynchronous systems, cloud services, data analysis, and AI model APIs. You will not be expected to know everything before joining; we care about your ability to learn and make steady, evidence\-based progress. **What You Will Learn** During the internship, you may gain practical experience in: * Building and debugging software used by real developers * Working with multiple commercial and open\-source AI model providers * Designing experiments and evaluating model behaviour * Measuring latency, cost, quality, failure rates, and recovery performance * Building reliable API integrations and distributed services * Understanding how AI gateways, routing systems, and token usage work * Translating research ideas into practical engineering decisions * Communicating technical findings clearly * Working in an early\-stage company where priorities evolve quickly **How The Internship Will Work** You will normally work through a complete project cycle: * Understand a technical problem and the user or product context. * Review existing approaches, documentation, and relevant research. * Form a hypothesis and define how success will be measured. * Build a small experiment, prototype, or test harness. * Analyse the results and identify limitations. * Discuss the findings with the engineering team. * Improve the solution and, where appropriate, help move it into production. * Document what was learned and what should happen next. The level of independence will increase as you become familiar with the platform. We provide direction and review, but you should be comfortable asking questions, investigating problems, and taking ownership of agreed tasks. **What We Are Looking For** We are looking for a university student who is curious, technically capable, and motivated to build real systems. **You Should Have** * Current university enrolment in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, mathematics, or a related field * Strong interest in AI models, software engineering, or developer infrastructure * Basic programming experience in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, C\+\+, or a similar language * Familiarity with APIs, Git, databases, or cloud services, through coursework or personal projects * Ability to break an unclear problem into smaller steps * Willingness to test assumptions and measure results rather than rely on guesses * Care with details, reproducibility, and technical documentation * Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively * Availability for a full\-time internship during the agreed internship period Prior professional experience is not required. Strong coursework, personal projects, research projects, hackathon work, open\-source contributions, GitHub repositories, or technical writing are welcome. You do not need prior experience with AI gateways, large language model infrastructure, or distributed systems. We value learning ability and practical curiosity more than a long list of tools. Helpful but not required **What Makes Someone a Strong Fit** You may be a strong fit if you: * Like understanding how things work rather than only using them * Enjoy both reading and building * Can turn a question into a small experiment * Are willing to start with an imperfect prototype and improve it * Care about whether your results are reliable and reproducible * Take responsibility for finishing work and communicating blockers early * Want to see your work used in a real product * Are excited by the fast\-moving AI infrastructure landscape in Asia This internship may not be the right fit if you are looking only for a passive learning experience, do not want to write or debug software, or prefer a fixed task list with no ambiguity. Early\-stage engineering work requires curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn unfamiliar systems. Why join NexLLM * Work on a live AI platform used by developers * Gain practical experience with multiple leading AI models and providers * Work directly with the founder and engineering team * Learn about model routing, evaluation, reliability, APIs, and cloud infrastructure * Build projects that can become real product capabilities * Receive feedback and guidance from experienced team members * Explore the intersection of applied AI research and product engineering * Help build a regional AI infrastructure capability from Hong Kong * Potentially be considered for future engineering opportunities based on performance and business needs **Compensation And University Coordination** This is a full\-time internship. Internship compensation, working arrangement, duration, start date, and any university documentation will be discussed with shortlisted candidates and confirmed before the internship begins. Candidates who need an internship agreement, supervisor information, learning objectives, progress reviews, or other university documentation should mention this when applying. **How To Apply** Please send the following to **info@nexllm.ai** : * CV or résumé * University, degree programme, year of study, and expected graduation date * Internship availability, including preferred start date and duration * GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio, coursework, research, or examples of technical work * A short note explaining why you are interested in NexLLM and AI infrastructure * One example of a technical problem, project, or experiment you worked on and what you learned **Subject:** AI R\&D Engineering Intern application - \[Your Name] NexLLM welcomes students from diverse backgrounds who are excited to learn, build, and contribute to the next generation of AI infrastructure in Asia.

jobs.description: OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa. Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Opportunity Core owns the foundational journeys that define a user's relationship with OKX: account management, identity verification, moving and securing funds, and the risk, compliance, and customer support experiences that sit alongside them. It also covers the internal enterprise tools our support agents, PMs, and operations teams rely on every day to serve customers and run the business. These are among the most consequential surfaces in the product. They determine whether users feel confident enough to trade, whether they trust us with their assets and their data, and whether the teams behind the scenes can resolve issues quickly and well. AI is central to how Core works and what Core builds. On the product side, we design AI-powered support and assistant experiences that help millions of users get answers and resolve issues in real time. Internally, we are an AI-native team: we use AI to move faster, sharpen our thinking, and raise the quality of what we ship, and we design the AI-native tools our internal teams depend on. If you are excited to design with AI and to shape how AI shows up for both customers and colleagues, this is a place to do it at scale. As a designer on Core, you'll take ownership of these high-stakes experiences end to end. The problems are genuinely hard. You'll design across markets with fundamentally different regulatory requirements, from newly regulated regions to our established global user base, and your work will need to satisfy strict compliance and security standards while still feeling fast, clear, and reassuring. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, legal, and compliance, shaping requirements early rather than executing them late. This is work where the details carry real weight. If you want to influence how millions of users experience crypto at its most critical moments, and how the teams supporting them get their work done, Core is one of the most impactful places to do it at OKX. What You’ll Be Doing Own complex, high-stakes journeys end to end across account, assets, compliance, or support, taking them from problem definition to shipped, polished execution. Design AI-powered experiences, from customer-facing assistant and support flows to AI-native internal tools, thinking through how people and AI work together, and where trust, transparency, and control matter most. Partner with product, engineering, legal, compliance, and risk to define the real problem, then design solutions that balance regulatory and security requirements with a genuinely good user experience. Produce the full range of design artifacts as needed: user flows, journey maps, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes, backed by evaluative research. Work in an AI-native way, using AI to accelerate exploration, prototyping, and decision-making, and helping raise the bar for how the team designs. Shape the design vision for your area alongside UX Research, UX Writing, and product leadership, and influence the roadmap early rather than delivering to it. Raise the quality bar through design reviews, critique, and workshops, and bring rigor to ambiguous, high-consequence problems. What We Look For In You We hire against a shared set of competencies. Beyond craft, we look for how you think, decide, collaborate, and drive work forward. Craft and expertise. Deep design craft with a sharp eye for detail, and up-to-date knowledge of your field. You analyze problems methodically and turn them into simple, effective solutions you can execute end to end. Judgment in ambiguity. You cut to the root of a problem, make sound calls even with incomplete information, and find the optimal path rather than the obvious one. Core problems are rarely clean, and good judgment is what keeps users safe. Business and product sense. You understand how the business works and where it's heading, and you connect design decisions to strategy, metrics, and real outcomes, not just the screen in front of you. Collaboration and communication. You communicate with clarity and precision, build genuine trust with product, engineering, legal, and compliance, and give and seek feedback that raises the whole team's work. Partners see you as a collaborator, not a service function. Drive and curiosity. You ask why before you design, stay resilient when problems are hard or ambiguous, and keep pushing your craft and ideas forward. You question the brief rather than just building it. AI fluency. Genuine fluency and enthusiasm for AI. You already use AI tools in your own work, and you're excited to design AI-driven experiences, not just adopt the buzzword. Experience designing complex, multi-step flows, ideally in fintech, crypto, or another regulated or high-trust domain. 3+ years of experience shipping end-to-end design solutions in cross-functional teams at a tech company. Nice to Haves Experience designing AI or conversational interfaces, or a track record of using AI to change how you work as a designer. Interest in designing complex internal tools and operational workflows, not just customer-facing surfaces. Exposure to data-informed design. You're comfortable interpreting user insights, behavioral data, or A/B test results. Familiarity with design systems and the ability to scale consistency across platforms. Prototyping skills to bring ideas to life and communicate transitions or microinteractions. Experience working across time zones with distributed teams. You know how to stay aligned and communicate with clarity. A degree in design, HCI, or a related field. Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process! You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology - setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes. What You'll Own Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development. Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality. Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution. Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems. Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability. Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions. Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations. Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar. Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale. Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat. Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production. Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues. Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams. Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes. Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes. Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled. To drive the continued development and growth of customer service standards, revenue and profits from multiple hotels and to deliver Hilton’s mission relating to profit, people, customer and quality. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique. Ensure that sales and pricing strategies are based on sound commercial judgement through effective analysis and reporting. Ensure professional and efficient utilization of all systems, in line with company best practices and standard operating procedures. Ensure effective information gathering and analysis is conducted to identify and maximise on all possible opportunities and minimise any risks. Ensure that relevant hotel and above-hotel commercial team members are actively engaged in all revenue decisions by maintaining regular communication to effectively implement, drive and review optimal strategies and controls. Integrate with other functions to ensure we exceed our customer’s, owner’s and shareholder expectations. Key Areas of Accountability Profit Ensure all best practices and standard operating procedures (SOP) are followed to capitalise and maximise revenue potential and market share. To utilise systems, tools and reports in the prescribed way to ensure all revenue management decisions are supported with relevant data analysis. Quality Follow best practices and SOP for the RMCC to ensure all commercial decisions are supported by appropriate data analysis. Feed ideas and suggestions to strive for constant improvement of operating procedures and new opportunities. Customer Build an effective working relationship with hotel commercial teams and operations to maintain their trust and confidence in the revenue management decisions and actions being taken pertaining to inventory and rate control, pricing and overbooking. People Work with the RMCC Assistant Director, Senior Cluster Revenue Managers and Training Manager as required to ensure all team members are provided with excellent training for Revenue Analyst and Revenue Management duties. Specific Accountabilities Inventory Control: Manages and maintains Group and Transient inventory controls Proactively reviews and implements room accommodation and rate inventory controls via IDeaS V5i and R&I daily. Ensure group inventory cut-off dates are managed in line with contracts and according to demand. Implement all blackout dates and reviews frequently to determine if adjustments are needed. Work with Front Office to ensure agreed sell-out strategies are in place. Maintain rate parity with third party sites through extranet sites. Proactively reviews key demand periods to maximise RevPAR and profit through effective consideration of costs of sales. Sales and Pricing Strategy: Develops, monitors and adjusts sales and pricing strategies Conduct weekly Business Focus & Group Review Meetings where the appropriate booking period is evaluated for proper rate and availability control. The Revenue Manager will provide a synopsis of results vs. direction from the previous week and lead discussion on future issues such as booking pace, pricing strategies, marketing opportunities and the competitive environment. Weekly reviews of GEM / Delphi / Database reports if available to address concerns and action plans relating to groups & events. Develop and reviews annual transient and group pricing and demand calendars on a quarterly basis. Ensure pricing is consistent in all distribution channels (QnQ R&I, GDS, Internet, Extranets). Identify opportunities through channels and recommends channel marketing. Liaise with market managers for key 3rd party operators. Liaise with HRCC and monitors conversion. Review corporate account production quarterly with sales to identify patterns & volume of production and agree appropriate actions. Conduct Daily Detail meeting / calls with hotel teams to highlight results, trends and changes to pricing and selling strategy for the next 3 months. Information Analysis and Monitoring: Provides critical analysis of strategies, room statistics and demand factors Perform relevant daily, weekly, monthly checklist tasks for the maintenance of the IDeaS V5i yield management system. Ensure the integrity of data flowing into IDeaS V5i by regularly cross-referencing other sources such as OnQ R&I and OnQ Insider reports. Review end of month room statistics reports and provide critical analysis on performance vs. forecasts and results of implemented strategies. Conduct displacement analysis of group business as needed to determine the impact potential business will have on RevPAR. Review all tentative and definite group bookings to ensure they support the implemented strategies - ensure IDeaS V5i Group Status is updated and Group Evaluator is used effectively. Complete weekly booking pace reports and analysis on pace, recommends strategy changes when needed. Analyse past and present trends and makes recommendations for future strategies. Ensure all ONQ R&I / SRP maintenance is configured according to the current standards - rms rates, yieldable flag, commissionable status. Ensure accuracy of all information being produced/ reported effectively. Forecasting: Prepare all weekly, monthly, 3 month forecast and budget using appropriate systems and tools Use specialist knowledge of the hotels and markets to produce and maintain hotel forecasts using prescribed tools. Prepare plan revenue proposal. Perform IDeaS V5i Forecast Validation process on a regular basis to identify changes in trends and opportunities to enhance IDeaS forecast. Competitive and Demand Analysis: Ensures rate shopping data is consistent, appropriate and effectively analysed Review all competitive shops on a daily basis and identifies selling strategies, opportunities and market trends. Review Demand Calendars, convention calendars and city event calendars to keep abreast of all demand generators on a weekly basis. Maintain historical data on events and performance on any promotions during these demand-generating events. Maintain IDeaS V5i interface where automated rate shopping is configured to ensure the yield system is configured for BAR adjustments appropriately. Proactively identifies peak nights and peak periods and sets KPI targets and action plans. Identify demand troughs and leads an action plan. Driving Commercial Performance: Drives incremental EBITDA, RevPar and Fair Market Share performance through the following Work effectively with RMCC Team members, Hotels (GMs, DBDs, C&E and on property revenue coordinator), Sales, RDRs, Marketing, e-commerce to ensure incremental financial performance (RevPar, EBITDA). Ensure growth in performance of KPIs such as Room Type Supplements, Peak Nights, House Overbooking and Forecast Accuracy. Drive Hotel Fair Market Share performance, moving hotels into the “Gaining” quadrants. Ensure any Holiday Cover commitments are managed as per standard. WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT You have these minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or higher. Practical work experience within hotel revenue management/asset management/feasibility. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and trends. Able to work independently and with the relevant stakeholders in global, regional, and hotel teams. Advanced Excel & Reporting: Pivot tables, forecasting models, data visualization. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Commercial attitude and proactive sales approach. Able to work accurately and effectively under pressure. Good personal presentation. Problem-Solving: Anticipates challenges and proactively addresses them. Team Player: Fosters a collaborative culture with a "win together" mindset. Fluent in English (written and spoken). Candidates are required to meet Hilton’s minimum qualifying score for the position-related assessments.

As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients. This role sits within the Global Sales Enablement (GSE) team and will work cross-functionally partnering with leaders from across Sales, Marketing, Technology and more. This business-facing role will be a catalyst in harnessing data, analytics, AI and technology to supercharge our tactics and deliver on our strategy. The leader will provide accretive ongoing feedback to development partners, contribute frontline input into prioritization decisions, improve integrity across the portfolio, and accelerate the impact of enablement initiatives to capitalize on money in motion. This individual will act as a strategic change and thought partner to sales teams and management, deeply understanding and embedding new capabilities that complement and accelerate our sales cycle. This includes ensuring comprehensive education including but not limited to workflow, sales tools, vendor solutions as well as packaging and proliferating best practices across teams. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in leading change management within complex organizations, preferably within the asset management industry, paired with the ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable adoption plans that drive measurable results. Key Responsibilities: Partnering with EMEA/APAC Wealth sales leadership development and drive the enablement roadmap Lead change management and adoption strategy for Wealth sales enablement initiatives that will scale globally. Build relationships across the front office and become primary enablement resource to the front office, providing enablement support and applying deep sales process expertise Identify change champions and drive adoption across teams and functions; proliferate best practices. Participate in territory business planning, embedding bespoke tactics and execution strategies, serving as a thought partner to sales and an execution conduit Drive and deliver communication, training, and stakeholder engagement plans Develop data-driven executive narratives that articulate digital priorities and enterprise impact Participate in vendor evaluation, selection, and implementation planning Measure success through defined adoption KPIs and associated business impact; provide regular reporting and insights to leadership The successful candidate is likely to have: 5 years of experience in Sales Enablement, COO functions, or Senior Training and Adoption roles within Banking, Finance, or Insurance Proven track record with large-scale change initiatives spanning sales, marketing, and management Experience collaborating with product owners and engineering teams to clarify business objectives and requirements Strong understanding of sales processes, with experience in a client-facing role or direct support of field sales Demonstrated ability to influence key stakeholders and implement strategic plans Experience with sales CRM platforms and sales workflow solutions Bachelor's degree Preferred qualifications: 8-10+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years in Sales Enablement, COO functions, or Senior Training and Adoption roles within Banking, Finance, or Insurance Local expertise capturing the regional nuances of asset management distribution Strong understanding of the asset management industry, with familiarity of alternative, fund and ETF investment products and distribution channels Experience designing and implementing programs that enhance sales productivity, effectiveness, and technology adoption This role can be based in Hong Kong, Singapore or London. Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds. The base salary range for this position is: EUR 85,000-175,000 This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered when making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; role; skills and experience; certifications; and education. jobs.description: **Growth \& Community Intern** Part\-time or full\-time · Remote\-first · Hong Kong timezone overlap preferred **About Everly AI** Everly AI is an ambient voice AI companion designed to help families stay seamlessly connected across generations and time zones. The platform focuses on creating meaningful, ongoing interactions that bridge physical distance and busy schedules. Everly AI is backed by HKSTP Ideation, providing strong support for innovation and growth. The company is founded by Chicago Booth alumni, combining technical expertise with business\-driven product thinking to build a scalable, globally relevant solution. **Our Mission** **Everly is dedicated to reducing loneliness in elder\-adults across the globe by bringing families closer together.** Across town or across the ocean, your mother eats alone. Your grandfather forgets a story he told you last week. jobs.title: AI Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.note: FreeHire 完整职位说明；地点和岗位类型由本站再次核对。
jobs.description: Midas is a fast-growing startup built on an AI-first mindset. We don't treat AI as a feature we bolt on at the end; it shapes how we design products, how we build them, and how we work day to day. We move quickly, ship often, and expect everyone on the team to own what they build. We're looking for an engineer who thinks the same way. The Role You'll be a full-stack engineer with AI running through everything you do. That means two things at once: Building AI into our products. You'll design and ship features that integrate LLMs, agents, retrieval, and other AI capabilities directly into our web and mobile applications, and you'll know which tools and models are the right fit for a given problem. Building with AI. You'll work with the best AI-assisted development tools available (coding agents, copilots, and whatever comes next) as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. You’ll own work end to end: from setting up the database and backend, to building the frontend for web and mobile, to deploying and iterating in production. What you'll do Design and build full-stack applications: database schema, backend services and APIs, and frontend interfaces for both web and mobile. Integrate AI capabilities into our products: LLM APIs, agent workflows, retrieval and embeddings, and model orchestration. Evaluate and select the right AI tools, models, and frameworks for each use case, and stay current as the landscape changes. Use AI-native development tools daily to build, test, and ship faster. Take features from idea to production with a high degree of autonomy. Contribute to technical decisions on architecture, tooling, and infrastructure. Who we’re looking for The most important thing is mindset. We want someone who is: AI-native. You understand the current generation of AI technology, use it constantly, and have strong opinions about what works. A self-directed learner. When you hit something you don't know, you go find out, experiment, and build. You don't wait to be taught. A builder. You’d rather ship something and improve it than talk about it. Comfortable with pace and ambiguity. Startups change fast. You're energised by that, not thrown by it. On the technical side, we’d like to see: Hands-on experience across the full stack: databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), backend development (e.g. Python, Node.js, or similar), and modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, Next.js). We are aligned to the Fidelity business units, Asset Management, Distribution and FIL Platform, as well as providing support at the Fidelity Group level, and to other Group Functions. General Counsel comprises of Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Corporate Sustainability and Enterprise Relationships, as well as Fidelity Foundations. Together with Internal Audit, we provide the second and third lines of defense, overseeing risk management, regulatory compliance and independent assurance activities across the business. We’re looking for individuals who are interested in joining us on a rotational programme in our General Counsel business and seeking challenging and rewarding work. **What you’ll be doing:** We don’t expect you to come straight in and know everything about what we do. We are supporting the Asset Management and Distribution businesses by providing practical advice and assistance on all relevant legal and regulatory matters as well as conduct rules. The Asset Management and Distribution businesses focus on our core investment activities and expertise as well as our offers to professional clients and financial institutions. We engage regularly with our many financial regulators all over the world. We analyse new laws and regulations and help with their implementation. jobs.title: Transaction Banking - Global Trade Solutions - Off-Cycle Internship
jobs.description: Area of Interest: Transaction Banking Business Area: Corporate and Institutional Banking Short Description: Turn trade insight into action with innovative solutions and global expertise About the business area Corporate and Institutional Banking helps some of the world’s largest companies grow and succeed by offering investment and financial solutions. Working across markets, sectors and borders, you’ll help deliver the insight, connectivity and support that enable clients to navigate change and unlock new opportunities Global Trade Solutions connects the world through trade. Our footprint gives clients access to over 80 per cent of world trade flows providing a powerful mixture of local, regional, and global knowledge to help them spot new opportunities. We provide a safer, smoother digital trade experience. We help clients solve business challenges through innovative solutions and strategic partners, and we bring them insights and ideas to enable them to grow and protect their businesses. Who you are You’re curious, motivated and interested in how global trade works in practice. You don’t need to know transaction banking inside out yet - what matters is your integrity, your drive to learn and your willingness to take ownership. You could be a great fit if you enjoy working with others, communicating clearly and building trusted relationships. You’re proactive, organised and comfortable spotting issues before they become bigger problems. You’re also interested in how businesses move goods, manage risk and operate across borders. If you want to understand the detail behind international trade while building practical skills in a global environment, this could be a strong fit. What you'll do You’ll work with teams that help clients trade internationally by providing working capital and risk management solutions. You could support activity across trade cycles, payments, documentation and risk, and see how deals move from idea through to execution. Your work might include helping with Letters of Credit, maintaining records, tracking trade transactions and currency movements, analysing data in Excel, and supporting reports or pitch materials. You’ll also work with colleagues involved in compliance and controls, carrying out checks such as sanctions screening and anti-money laundering reviews. It’s practical work with exposure to both the detail and the bigger picture of global trade. What you'll learn You’ll build the technical knowledge, practical understanding and professional skills needed to understand transaction banking with confidence. Through structured training and hands-on learning, you’ll deepen your understanding of trade cycles, compliance requirements, stakeholder engagement and how Sales and Product teams support clients in different ways. You’ll also strengthen your awareness of anti-money laundering, sanctions and trade law, so you can see how global trade is supported responsibly. Working with colleagues across business areas will help you build a broader view of how the bank fits together. By the end of the internship, you’ll have a stronger foundation in Global Trade Solutions and a clearer sense of how your skills could grow in this space. Where you'll work You’ll work in Global Trade Solutions within Corporate and Institutional Banking, alongside teams that support clients trading across borders. It’s a collaborative environment where product, operations, client coverage and risk teams work together to keep trade moving smoothly. You’ll be part of a professional office culture that values teamwork, accuracy and commercial awareness. Expect exposure to an international banking environment where different functions connect closely and where detail matters. Eligibility Criteria To be eligible, you must: Be available to work full time from March 2027 onwards Have obtained, or expect to achieve, a 2:1 degree classification or higher, or an overseas equivalent Be fluent in English Have completed studies, or will have complete them by the end of March 2027 We will consider candidates that require visa sponsorship for this role We only accept one application per recruitment cycle so please take time to explore our opportunities before applying as we may not be able to transfer your application to other vacancies. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of applications. Please apply as soon as possible to be considered.

jobs.description: Wing is a fast-growing, Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed multinational startup. We are looking for an exceptional, highly motivated individual to serve as a Client Delivery Operations Manager. The Client Delivery Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management, visibility, and operational health of Wing's end-to-end client fulfillment pipeline.This role ensures that opportunities and accounts move efficiently through each stage of the business, from Sales handoff, talent requirements, recruitment and staffing, candidate presentation, client selection, onboarding, launch, and early account stabilization. The Client Delivery Operations Manager serves as the central operational owner of the pipeline, continuously monitoring movement, identifying bottlenecks, enforcing timelines, coordinating cross-functional teams, and resolving process gaps that could delay revenue, staffing, or client activation. This is not primarily an administrative tracking role. The position is expected to actively manage the pipeline, challenge stalled items, drive accountability, escalate risks, and improve the underlying processes that keep the pipeline moving. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Pipeline Management Own the daily operational management of Wing's active pipeline. Maintain visibility across every account and requirement from Sales handoff through successful launch. Ensure every pipeline item has a clear status, owner, next action, and expected completion date. Monitor accounts that are stalled, delayed, blocked, or at risk. Proactively follow up with responsible teams to move accounts forward. Ensure pipeline stages accurately reflect the actual operational status of each account. 2. Pipeline Health Monitoring Conduct daily reviews of pipeline movement and outstanding requirements. Identify aging accounts, stalled stages, capacity issues, and process bottlenecks. Flag accounts at risk of missing staffing or launch timelines. Monitor pipeline volume against available recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and operational capacity. Maintain clear visibility into what is entering, moving through, and exiting the pipeline. 3. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with: Sales Customer Success Talent Acquisition Staffing Onboarding Training Operations Product or specialized service teams Finance and other support teams when required Ensure clean handoffs between departments and prevent accounts from being delayed because of unclear ownership or incomplete information. 4. Sales-to-Operations Handoff Review newly closed accounts and confirm that operational requirements are complete. Validate role requirements, client expectations, staffing needs, timelines, and special conditions. Identify incomplete, unrealistic, or unclear requirements before they create downstream delays. Coordinate with Sales when clarification or expectation resetting is required. Ensure specialized products or services follow the correct operational process. 5. Staffing and Candidate Pipeline Oversight Monitor recruitment and staffing progress against client requirements. Track candidate availability, endorsement, interviews, client selections, replacements, and pending decisions. Identify roles with insufficient candidate supply or prolonged staffing timelines. Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and Staffing leadership on priority requirements. Escalate accounts requiring intervention, sourcing adjustments, compensation review, or expectation management. 6. Client Selection and Decision Management Track candidates presented to clients and outstanding client decisions. Ensure follow-ups occur within established timelines. Identify accounts where client responsiveness is delaying fulfillment. Coordinate with CSMs, OBS, Sales, or account owners when client intervention is required. Maintain visibility into candidate rejection reasons and recurring selection barriers. 7. Onboarding and Launch Readiness Monitor accounts approaching onboarding and launch. Confirm that staffing, documentation, equipment, access, training, schedules, and client requirements are ready. Surface launch risks before they become client-facing issues. Coordinate resolution between responsible departments. Ensure accounts transition cleanly from pipeline management into normal account operations. 8. Pipeline Escalation Management Serve as the first operational escalation point for pipeline-related issues. Examples include: Staffing delays Missing client requirements Candidate shortages Interview delays Client decision delays Incorrect Sales handoffs Compensation mismatches Training capacity concerns Onboarding blockers Ownership gaps System or CRM inaccuracies Accounts repeatedly moving backward in the pipeline Determine the appropriate owner, establish an action plan, and monitor the issue until resolution. 9. Pipeline Governance and Accountability Establish and enforce pipeline SLAs. Ensure teams update their respective pipeline stages consistently. Hold stakeholders accountable for overdue actions. Require clear next steps for every active account. Escalate repeated SLA breaches or operational blockers to leadership. Ensure pipeline meetings focus on decisions and corrective actions rather than status reporting alone. 10. Pipeline Reporting and Forecasting Provide leadership with clear visibility into: Total active pipeline New accounts entering the pipeline Accounts staffed Accounts awaiting candidates Accounts awaiting client decisions Accounts scheduled for launch Aging by pipeline stage Average time spent per stage Staffing turnaround time Bottleneck trends At-risk accounts Projected launches Expected revenue activation Pipeline capacity and resource constraints Produce weekly and monthly pipeline health reports with clear recommendations and required leadership actions. 11. Process Improvement Continuously evaluate how accounts move through Wing's pipeline. Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, unclear ownership, and communication gaps. Design improved workflows and escalation protocols. Recommend automation opportunities. Partner with system owners to improve CRM and pipeline architecture. Standardize handoff requirements between departments. Document processes, SLAs, escalation paths, and ownership matrices. Measure whether process changes improve pipeline velocity and client experience. Required Qualifications Strong experience in operations, program management, revenue operations, staffing operations, customer success operations, or similar environments. Demonstrated ability to manage complex workflows involving multiple departments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Comfortable working with high-volume operational pipelines. Strong understanding of SLAs, workflow management, escalation management, and process optimization. Excellent stakeholder management and follow-through. Ability to challenge teams constructively and drive accountability. Strong written and verbal communication. Experience using CRM, project management, reporting, and workflow management platforms. Ability to interpret operational data and convert findings into actionable recommendations. Able to travel to the Philippines as required. Preferred Qualifications Experience in BPO, outsourcing, staffing, recruitment, SaaS, or service-based organizations. Experience managing client implementation or fulfillment pipelines. Experience working across Sales, Recruitment, Customer Success, and Operations. Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, Power BI, or similar systems Experience designing SLAs, dashboards, workflow automation, or operational governance.

jobs.description: ABOUT US We’re the world’s leading provider of secure financial messaging services, headquartered in Belgium.
